title: The stone head in snow
logline: Rare snow. The face with a cap of it, the eyes two dark places, the grass gone white to the wall. The pup's prints, two-one, circling it.

panels.composition: The stone face under a cap of rare snow, its eye-hollows the only dark, the grass white to the shingle wall, and around it a circle of small three-legged dog prints in a two-one rhythm. The dog out of frame.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a carved stone head with a cap of snow and dark eye hollows in a snowy patch by a shingle wall, a circle of small three-legged dog prints in the snow around it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
